column1: # tests/fixtures/rollback_target_chain_cases.tsv — the D5 rollback-target
# chain parity table (AC-D5-12, self-service-promote Wave 3).
# TAB-separated; `#` lines are comments; `-` = ABSENT (JSON null / field
# not written). Columns:
#   name <TAB> target <TAB> live <TAB> capture <TAB> to <TAB> current <TAB> displaced <TAB> previous <TAB> expect_kind <TAB> expect_value <TAB> expect_source
# expect_kind: resolve|halt; expect_value = the version or the halt reason;
# expect_source = the resolving rung (resolve rows only).
# Resolved IDENTICALLY by lib.sh (_rollback_target_resolve), launcher.sh
# (_js_rollback_target_resolve), and the Python resolver
# (daemon/services/rollback_target_chain.py) — the pack
# tests/packs/rollback_target_chain_parity_test.sh drives all three.
# Fixture releases present: vA vB vC vD vE vT. NOT present: vZ.
# r0-wins-over-all: a VALID capture (R0) resolves OVER every conflicting
# lower rung (clarification (i) — short-circuit; R2/R3/R4 disagreement is
# a resolved-over stale-field difference, never a halt).
r0-wins-over-all
# lost-capture / new-format-absent: no capture ⇒ the documented fall-
# through disposition — R2==R3 agree ⇒ resolved at the current rung.
lost-capture-fall-through
# AC-D5-4: no capture + current ≠ displaced (both valid) ⇒ halt, never a
# wrong rollback; the txn stays OPEN.
no-capture-conflict-halt
# F3: present-but-invalid R0 ⇒ HALT capture_invalid — NEVER fall through.
present-invalid-r0-eq-target
present-invalid-r0-missing-dir
present-invalid-r0-eq-live-link
# CYCLE-2 MAJOR-1 (2026-11-20): a NUMERIC or `none` capture token folds
# ABSENT at ALL THREE resolvers (the ruling's "treated ABSENT by all
# three" premise — the python _clean non-string fold; the shell seams
# receive the stringified fragment and fold the identical token set,
# _rollback_rung_absent / _js_rollback_rung_absent). The pack was blind
# to this class (all-text fixtures) while the pre-fix shells HALTED
# capture_invalid — these rows pin the fold: resolution falls through to
# the R2 current rung exactly as the python resolver does.
r0-numeric-capture-folded-absent
r0-exponent-capture-folded-absent
r0-none-capture-folded-absent
# AC-D5-7 (first half): a VALID to= disagreeing with a VALID R0 ⇒ halt.
r1-valid-conflicts-r0
# AC-D5-7 (second half): a to= failing VALID (== target / missing dir) is
# treated as ABSENT — never a candidate, never a halt (F5).
r1-eq-target-treated-absent
r1-missing-dir-treated-absent
# R1 resolves when R0 is absent (the daemon's request nominates a valid
# destination; the launcher never invents one).
r1-resolves-when-r0-absent
# R2 == target (the stale post-flip current) ⇒ INVALID ⇒ falls to R3.
stale-current-eq-target-falls-to-r3
# R4 (journal.previous, G1) is the last rung.
only-previous-remains
# R4 null ⇒ the mapped EXISTING halt ("journal has no previous release").
no-candidate-no-previous
# R4 == target ⇒ the same halt (never roll back onto the failed target).
r4-eq-target-halts
